_comment: The map database of D33: reveal tuning and every landmark the map may ever show. Data-driven so Band 1-4 landmarks (quarry, warrens, river, mill, relay) join by editing this file, not code. Tunable.
_comment_south_bridge: SC14, spec 3 Gate 1. A `major` landmark rather than a `minor` one: it is the chapter's first physical gate and the thing the whole south road exists to reach, not a piece of furniture on the way somewhere else. NOT a `silhouette` -- the stronghold is drawn before discovery because it is meant to be seen from across the meadow and never reached; the bridge is meant to be walked to on day one, so it appears the ordinary way, by going there. Position is the gully carve's own centre (terrain_playground.json `crossings[0].carve.centre`); if that moves, this moves.
_comment_regions: Owner directive, playtest pass: 'name some of the areas and uncover them like fortnite maps do.' A region is broader than a landmark -- the AREA around a point of interest, not the point itself -- and is discovered by entering it (map_state.gd::update_region), not by proximity like a landmark. A region is NOT one destination: a real Fortnite map names a handful of large, well-separated zones, not one per building. The first cut of this named village square, Grandpa's house and the practice meadow as three separate regions -- all real destinations (data/config/terrain_playground.json's own paths.routes[].label) but only 15-35m apart, so their labels landed on top of each other on the full map and read as clutter rather than geography. They are now one region, matching what they actually are: the single starting hub the player spends their first minutes in. The Pond and The Rise stay separate -- 150m+ from the hub and 230m from each other, genuinely distinct places a player walks TO, not three names for one dooryard. TUNABLE.
_comment_the_old_quarry: SD16, and D36's rule applied rather than quoted: few and LARGE. This is one region for the whole worked site -- the quarry floor, its foundations, the standing dead, and the conduit run leaving it on the stronghold bearing -- not one per feature, exactly the mistake D36 was written to correct. Its centre sits between the floor ([23,158]) and the first pylon out ([31.7,148.4]) so the map label lands over the site rather than off one edge of it, and 62m carries the whole run out to [41,121]. Separation from every existing region is comfortable: 175m to Grandpa's Village, 130m to The Pond, 205m to The Rise -- no two labels can crowd each other the way the first regions cut did. Discovery is by ENTERING it (map_state.gd::update_region), which for this region means having crossed the South Bridge, so the name arrives at the moment the gate pays off. TUNABLE.
